thesis: Aeolipile gave every color access to two points of direct damage through an artifact, a modest effect whose importance came from crossing the color pie at a low cost.

competitiveTimeline.significance: Aeolipile became a practical tool in early constructed and later Pauper environments, demonstrating how valuable colorless removal can be even at an inefficient rate.
